title: Build the primary RF authority rule matrix
description:
Build a dated primary-source matrix for ordinary FHSS, DTS, hybrid operation, equipment changes, antennas, module integration, unwanted emissions and applicable RF exposure requirements. Cover 47 CFR 15.247, 2.1043 and applicable FCC guidance. Distinguish rule text, guidance, device-specific conditions and unresolved interpretation.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Read-only source research. Existing conference decision project-LICHEN-worker6-b79z selected Part 15 ISM; do not reopen that choice or revive deferred funding applications. Research findings confer no permission to contact an authority, file documents or transmit.
acceptance_criteria: Each requirement has an authoritative citation, effective or retrieval date and applicability conditions. Record the distinct bandwidth, channel-count, occupancy, power and hybrid test branches without selecting a deployment's regulatory classification. Unsupported interpretations remain human questions.
close_reason: Built docs/rf-authority-matrix.md: dated primary-source matrix (retrieved 2026-09-09, eCFR current 2026-09-04) covering ordinary FHSS/DTS/hybrid (15.247 all branches incl. 250kHz BW split, 50/25ch, 20s/10s occupancy, 1W/0.25W, PSD, 15.247(f)-(h)), equipment changes (2.1043 classes I/II/III + new-grant triggers), antennas (15.203 + 15.247(b)(4)/(c), no 902-928 PtP exception), module integration (15.212), unwanted emissions (15.247(d)+15.205+15.209 full table), RF exposure (1.1307(b)/1.1310/2.1091/2.1093). Rule/guidance/device/unresolved classes distinguished; no deployment classification selected; human questions reserved. Docs-only: no tests applicable. 3x review (kimi-k3): correctness PASS (15.247/2.1043/1.1310 verified verbatim + arithmetic); security PASS after 1 pinpoint fix (1.1310(d)(4) not 'note'); edge-cases 6 minor findings, all fixed pre-commit (hybrid-row citation, full 15.209 table, averaging-clause wording per 2.1091(d)(2)(ii), exemption pinpoint tightened to 2.1091(c)(1) — reviewer's suggested (b)(1)(i)(B) was itself wrong, Category One mitigation mischaracterization, legend class added).
